title: Evaporator Fan System Error
fullDescription:
SY EF indicates the evaporator fan system has a fault. Airflow through the freezer is insufficient.

May be frost blockage or failed fan motor.

title: Communication Error
fullDescription: SY CE indicates internal communication between boards has failed.

title: Low Flow Water
fullDescription: SY LF indicates the water dispenser flow sensor detects low or no flow. Check filter and supply.
videoSearchQuery: Electrolux refrigerator SY LF water flow

title: Open Sensor
fullDescription: OP means a temperature sensor reads open. The specific sensor depends on which compartment displays the code.

faq.a: Depends on which compartment shows code.

title: Closed Sensor
fullDescription: CL indicates a shorted thermistor. Replace the corresponding sensor.

title: High Temperature Alert
fullDescription: HI warns that fridge or freezer is too warm. Check door seal, airflow, and cooling system.

title: Low Temperature Alert
fullDescription: LO indicates one compartment is too cold. Thermostat or damper stuck open.

title: Fresh Food Sensor Fault
fullDescription: Error 1 means the fresh food thermistor has failed. Replace sensor.

title: Freezer Sensor Fault
fullDescription: Error 2 indicates the freezer thermistor is bad. Replace it.

title: Freezer Fan Fault
fullDescription: FF indicates freezer fan is locked, typically by ice or motor failure.

faq.a: Yes with hair dryer on low.

title: Condenser Fan System Error
fullDescription: SY CF indicates the condenser fan system has failed. This cools the compressor and is vital for cooling.
videoSearchQuery: Electrolux refrigerator SY CF condenser fan

title: Ice Maker Fault
fullDescription: Error 5 indicates ice maker fault. May be water supply, motor, or thermistor issue.

faq.a: Yes via switch, will silence code.
